Core Memories 📸

🌸 A Tribute to My Sister

“Udan Pirakatha En Uyire Thangai Revathi!”

Udan pirakavillai,
Oru thai vayitril valaravillai,
Aanaal en uyir kooda valarnthaval nee thaan.

Ratham onnu illa,
Aanaal paasam rathathai vida perusu nu,
Namaku Puriya vaithathu nam anna thangai uravu.

Ulagam aaiyaram sonnathu,
“Aval un kooda pirakavillai” endru,
Enakku theriyum,
Nee en kooda pirakavillai,
Enakkaga pirakka patta aval endru.

En vazhkkai la,
Naan ketkama kidaitha periya varam nee thaan.

Enakku oru thangachi venum nu,
Naan kadavul kitta ketkave illa,
Aana avar enakkaga unna anuppi vechitaaru.

Naan irukkum varai,
Un kannula kannir varave koodathu,
Un mukathula sirippu mattum thaan irukanum.

nee en udan pirakatha thangachi illa,
Nee en uyir kooda pirantha thangachi!

💖 Happy birthday thangachi 🎂

A Note From Me 💌

Dear Revathi,

Thank you for always having my back, bringing joy and laughter into our home, and being my built-in best friend for life. May this year bring you everything you’ve been working toward—abundant happiness, good health, and success in every step!

Always cheering for you,
— Your brother Boopathy 💖
